Icons per author (153 icons; Phase 25 added 11: Lorc 5, Delapouite 6, downloaded 2026-11-14):
  Lorc 75, Delapouite 60, sbed 4, Skoll 4, Guard13007 2, Carl Olsen 2, Willdabeast 2,
  DarkZaitzev 1, Faithtoken 1, Lucas (lucasms) 1, Zeromancer 1.

Files:
  Source/<author>/<icon>.svg  - the original SVG, unmodified.
  Resources/RkIcons/<icon>.png - 512 x 512 PNG rendered by game-icons.net as white on transparent
                                 (https://game-icons.net/icons/ffffff/transparent/1x1/<author>/<icon>.png).
                                 They are tinted at run time.

Changes: colour (white on transparent), and tinting in the interface. Shapes are unchanged.
The key-to-icon list is Tools/UI/icon-manifest.tsv.
